questions.question: In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements. Statements: All clowns are books. Some books are heavy. Some heavy are trucks. Conclusions: I. Some books are clowns. II. All books are heavy. III. Some trucks are heavy.
questions.questionHtml:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

All clowns are books.

Some books are heavy.

Some heavy are trucks.

Conclusions:

I. Some books are clowns.

II. All books are heavy.

III. Some trucks are heavy.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
options.html: Only conclusions I and II follow.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.
options.html: Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:


 

Conclusions:

I. Some books are clowns → Follow (As, all clowns are books. So, as whole clowns comes in books therefore it is definitely true.)

II. All books are heavy → Does not Follow (As, some books are heavy. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

III. Some trucks are heavy → Follow (As, some heavy are trucks . So, as some part of heavy is common with trucks therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:

questions.solution: President of India, Droupadi Murmu presented the 7<sup>th</sup> edition of the Digital India Awards on 7th January 2023 in New Delhi. NIC's eAbkari & Invest Punjab got Gold & Silver at Digital India Awards 2022. Ksheerasree Portal by NIC won Silver for grassroots level initiatives. Transport Mission Project (eTransport MMP) received Gold. questions.question: Which of the following is the closest wild relative of domestic cattle protected in some of the famous national parks of India like Nagarhole and Bandipur?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is the closest wild relative of domestic cattle protected in some of the famous national parks of India like Nagarhole and Bandipur?
questions.solution: The Gaur, also known as the Indian Bison, is the closest wild relative of domestic cattle. It is protected in several national parks in India, including Nagarhole and Bandipur in Karnataka. Gaurs are the largest and most powerful of all wild cattle.

questions.questionHtml: What is the name of the scheme launched to fund infrastructure and social development projects in the Northeast for a period of four years from 2022 - 23 to 2025 -26?
questions.solution: PM-DevINE is a 4-year scheme (2022-26) by Ministry of DoNER with Rs. 6,600 crore funding. It aims to fund infrastructure, support livelihoods, and bridge development gaps in NE. questions.question: Which part of the Constitution of India contains the provisions of Union Executive?
questions.questionHtml: Which part of the Constitution of India contains the provisions of Union Executive?
questions.solution: Part V of the Constitution of India, spanning Articles 52 to 151, contains provisions for the Union Executive. It outlines the roles, powers, and functions of the President, Vice-President, Council of Ministers, Attorney General, and Comptroller and Auditor General, along with procedures for their appointments and responsibilities.

questions.question: Which of the following countries won the highest number of gold medals in the Tokyo Paralympic 2020?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following countries won the highest number of gold medals in the Tokyo Paralympic 2020?
questions.solution: China led the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics with 96 gold and 207 total medals, followed by UK and USA. Zhou Jiamin from China stood out with 3 golds in Shooting. China excelled in Table Tennis. The event featured 4,537 athletes from 163 countries, introducing Badminton and Taekwondo for the first time.

questions.question: Which of the following countries has hosted the three Asian Games?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following countries has hosted the three Asian Games?
questions.solution: Having staged four different editions (1966, 1970, 1978 and 1998) Thailand is the only country which has hosted the most number of Asian Games. The Thai capital of Bangkok has hosted all four Games. South Korea have hosted the Asian Games thrice (1986, 2002 and 2014).

questions.question: Who led the English army in the Battle of Buxar?
questions.questionHtml: Who led the English army in the Battle of Buxar?
questions.solution: Battle of Buxar, 1764: Indian allies (Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, Shah Alam II) vs British East India Company led by Major Hector Munro. Despite larger forces, Indian allies were defeated, marking British supremacy. A crucial moment in British imperial expansion in India.

questions.question: Which of the following amendments to the Indian Constitution made the Right to Property a Legal Right in place of a Fundamental Right?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following amendments to the Indian Constitution made the Right to Property a Legal Right in place of a Fundamental Right?
questions.solution: The 44th Amendment of 1978 removed the Right to Property as a Fundamental Right and made it a legal right under Article 300A of the Constitution. Initially recognized under Articles 19(1)(f) and 31, this change enabled land reforms and redistribution without judicial hurdles.

questions.question: Changai dance is associated with which Indian state?
questions.questionHtml: Changai dance is associated with which Indian state?
questions.solution: The Changai dance is indeed associated with the Indian state of Nagaland. It is a traditional folk dance of the Chang tribe in Nagaland. The Changai dance is performed during various festive occasions and celebrations within the Chang community.

questions.question: Which is the national fruit of Bangladesh?
questions.questionHtml: Which is the national fruit of Bangladesh?
questions.solution: Bangladesh's national fruit is jackfruit, cherished for its taste and nutrition. It thrives in the climate, used in curries and more. From canned to dried forms, it's versatile. Each year, a jackfruit tree produces 150-500 fruits, seeds rich in Vitamins B1, B2, starch. With 100-500 seeds per fruit, its affordability and nutrition make it the ideal national fruit.

questions.question: Which of the following chemicals is used as a preservative to slow browning and discolouration in foods and beverages during preparation, storage and distribution?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following chemicals is used as a preservative to slow browning and discolouration in foods and beverages during preparation, storage and distribution?
questions.solution: Sulphites occur naturally in foods like dried fruits, wine, and beer. They're used as additives to prevent browning and spoilage. Sulphites release sulphur dioxide (SO<sub>2</sub>), causing allergy-like symptoms in asthma patients and those with urticaria. 13% of asthma sufferers have sulphite sensitivity. Labels on products with sulphites aid informed choices.

questions.question: Which of the following reforming societies believed Vedas to be the fountain of all the knowledge?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following reforming societies believed Vedas to be the fountain of all the knowledge?
questions.solution: In 1875, Swami Dayanand founded Arya Samaj to propagate Vedic knowledge, reject Hindu society's ills, oppose polytheism, and promote social reform. It fought untouchability, caste rigidity, and promoted equality. Arya Samaj led Shuddhi Movement, reclaiming Hindu converts. Emphasizing Vedas, it printed them for the first time in India. Swami Dayanand's key work was "Satyartha Prakasha."

questions.question: Seismograph is used to measure:
questions.questionHtml: Seismograph is used to measure:
questions.solution: Epicenter and Focus of Earthquakes: Seismographs play a crucial role in locating the epicenter (geographical location directly above the focus on the surface) and the focus (actual location within the earth where the earthquake originates) of an earthquake. Data collected from minimum three seismograph stations is used to triangulate the epicenter of an earthquake.

questions.question: This event is celebrated to mark the resurrection of Christ. Identify the event.
questions.questionHtml: This event is celebrated to mark the resurrection of Christ. Identify the event.
questions.solution: Easter is a significant religious holiday observed by Christians worldwide to commemorate the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, as described in the New Testament of the Bible. The resurrection is believed to have occurred on the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, which is traditionally known as Good Friday.

questions.question: Which of the following is another name for starch found mainly in the pulp of seeds, fruits, tubers, roots and stems of plants, especially in corn, potatoes, wheat and rice?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is another name for starch found mainly in the pulp of seeds, fruits, tubers, roots and stems of plants, especially in corn, potatoes, wheat and rice?
questions.solution: "Amylum" is Latin for starch, a white plant chemical stored as glucose in chloroplasts. Vital plant energy reserve. Human staple foods (potatoes, wheat, rice) rich in starch. Used in adhesives, paper, textiles, and food additives. Amylases break it into glucose units. Amylose (straight) forms helix for energy storage; amylopectin (branched) offers quick release.

questions.question: Which of the following systems of the Delhi sultanate influenced the Bahmani and Vijayanagar kingdoms?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following systems of the Delhi sultanate influenced the Bahmani and Vijayanagar kingdoms?
questions.solution: The Iqtadari system of the Delhi Sultanate influenced the Bahmani and Vijayanagara kingdoms. While not directly part of the Sultanate, both adopted similar revenue collection practices. Iqtadars controlled territories for revenue, aiding efficient administration and revenue collection in these kingdoms.

questions.question: What is the product formed when CH 3 CH 2 OH reacts with O 2 ?
questions.questionHtml: What is the product formed when CH<sub>3</sub>CH<sub>2</sub>OH reacts with O<sub>2</sub>?

options.text: CO 2 + H 2 O + heat and light

questions.solution: When ethanol (CH3CH2OH) undergoes complete combustion with oxygen (O2), the products formed are carbon dioxide (CO2) and water (H2O). This reaction is an example of rapid oxidation, where a substance reacts with oxygen to release energy in the form of heat and light. questions.question: A, B and C run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 1200 m, at respective speeds of 2 m/s, 4 m/s and 6 m/s. A and B run in the same direction, while C runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.questionHtml: A, B and C run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 1200 m, at respective speeds of 2 m/s, 4 m/s and 6 m/s. A and B run in the same direction, while C runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution:
Relative speed of A and B = (4 + 2) = 6 m/s ; Relative speed of B and C = (6 + 4) = 2 m/s ; Relative speed of A and C = (6 + 2) = 8 m/s

Time taken by A and B = 1200/2 = 600 sec ; Time taken by B and C = 1200/10 = 120 sec ; Time taken by A and C = 1200/8 = 150 sec

A, B and C will meet at = L.C.M {600,120, 150} = 600 sec = 600/60 = 10 minutes

questions.solution:
Amount produce in 7 years = Rs.14522 ; Amount produce in 11 years = Rs.18906

S.I produced in (11 - 7) = 4 years = (18906 - 14522) = Rs.4384 ⇒ S.I in 1 years = 4384/4 = 1096

Principal = 14522 - (1096 × 7) ⇒ (14522 - 7672) = Rs.6850

questions.solution:

20 A 30 600

12 C 50

⇒ (20 + 15 + 12) = 47 units = 3 days ⇒ 47 × 12 = 564 units = 3 × 12 = 36 days ⇒ (564 + 20 + 15) = 599 units = 38 days

questions.question: A thief is spotted by a constable from 200 m. When the constable starts the chase, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the constable is 8 km/h and thief runs at the speed of 6 km/h, then how far (in m) will the thief be able to run before he is overtaken?
questions.questionHtml: A thief is spotted by a constable from 200 m. When the constable starts the chase, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the constable is 8 km/h and thief runs at the speed of 6 km/h, then how far (in m) will the thief be able to run before he is overtaken?
questions.solution:
Time = (200 ×18)/(8 - 6) × 2 ⇒ (200 × 18)/10 ⇒ time = 360 sec

Distance covered by thief = 6 × (5/18) × 360 = 600 m

questions.question: 15 men can complete a work in 25 days, and 25 women can complete the same work in 40 days. If all 15 men and 25 women work together, in how many days will the work get completed?
questions.questionHtml: 15 men can complete a work in 25 days, and 25 women can complete the same work in 40 days. If all 15 men and 25 women work together, in how many days will the work get completed?
questions.solution:
15 × M × 25 = 25 × W × 40 ⇒ M/W = 40/15 = 8/3

Total work =  efficiency × time ⇒ 25 × 3 × 40 = 3000

Time taken to complete the work if 15 men and 25 women work together ⇒ 3000/{(15 × 8) + (25 × 3)} ⇒ 3000/(120 + 75) ⇒ 3000/195 = \(15 \frac{5}{13}\) days

questions.solution: (90000 × 30%) + (y × 40%) = (90000 + y) × 37% ⇒ 27000 + y × 40% = 33,300 + y × 37% ⇒ y × 3% = 6300 ⇒ y = (6300 × 100)/3 ⇒ y = 210000

Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined words in the given sentence.

Developed countries are at a disadvantage to have access to modern science and technologies.
questions.solution: A disadvantage is a problem-causing state or scenario, especially one that causes something or someone to be less successful than other things or people. Marked choice Privileged refers to having unique privileges or benefits.  As a result, it is evident that "privileged" is the best antonym in the provided sentence.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. According to Homer, Achilles was brought up by his mother at Phthia with his inseparable companion Patroclus. B. Achilles was the bravest, handsomest and greatest warrior of the army of Agamemnon in the Trojan War. C. Later non - Homeric tales suggest that Patroclus was Achilles' kinsman or lover. D. Achilles, in Greek mythology, is the son of the mortal Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, and the Nereid Thetis.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. According to Homer, Achilles was brought up by his mother at Phthia with his inseparable companion Patroclus.

B. Achilles was the bravest, handsomest and greatest warrior of the army of Agamemnon in the Trojan War.

C. Later non - Homeric tales suggest that Patroclus was Achilles' kinsman or lover.

D. Achilles, in Greek mythology, is the son of the mortal Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, and the Nereid Thetis.
questions.solution: The paragraph follows the sequence: D -> B -> A -> C. This arrangement provides a coherent overview of Achilles' background, characteristics, relationships, and mythology. Thus, option 2 is the right choice.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Capable".

Key Points

  • 'Capable' means having the ability or skill to do something.
  • It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 as it fits the context of the sentence.
    • Example: She is capable of handling difficult situations.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Additional Information

  • Option 1 - 'able' also means having the ability to do something, but 'capable' is a better fit in this context.
  • Option 3 - 'durable' means able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage, and is not related to the context of the sentence.
  • Option 4 - 'curable' means able to be cured, and is not related to the context of the sentence.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "within".
 Key Points
  • "Within" is the most appropriate preposition to use in this context.
  • It means "inside" or "not exceeding a certain time frame".
    • Example: "The package will be delivered within 3 days."
  • "In" could also work in some cases, but "within" is more specific.
  • "Without" and "with" are not appropriate choices for this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 4".

Additional Information

  • Option 1: "In" could work in some cases, but it is less specific than "within".
  • Option 2: "With" is not a preposition that makes sense in this sentence.
  • Option 3: "Without" is the opposite of "within" and does not fit the context.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "than".
Key Points
  •  "Than" is used for comparisons, while "then" is used for indicating time or sequence.
    • Example: "She is taller than her sister." (comparison)
  • "Than" can also be used to express preference or exception.
    • Example: "I would rather stay home than go to the party."
  • In this question, "than" is the appropriate word because it is comparing Option 3 to the other options.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Additional Information

  • Option 1, "then", is incorrect because it does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
  • Option 3, "that", is incorrect because it is a conjunction and does not fit grammatically in the sentence.
  • Option 4, "what", is incorrect because it is a pronoun and does not fit grammatically in the sentence.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Option 3".
Key Points
  • In English grammar, the adjective 'capable' is followed by the preposition 'of' when referring to a certain ability or potential.
  • After the term 'capable', the noun (or, in this case, the pronoun) is often followed by an '-ing' form of a verb.
  • It defines what someone or something is capable of doing. In this instance, the word succeeding 'capable' ('of') is elided and understood in the context of the sentence.
  • 'Capable of' is a standard collocation and widely accepted in academic and formal writing.
  • Therefore, in terms of syntactical norms and for the sentence to make sense, the preposition 'of' perfectly fits in the given context.
Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".
Additional Information
  • 'About': The preposition 'about' usually denotes the topic of discussion or describes something in a general way. It is not the correct choice here due to rule of Collocation.
  • 'Off': The preposition 'off' denotes disconnection or separation and it is not grammatically correct to use here.
  • 'On': 'On' doesn't fit well here as the common structure 'capable on' does not exist in English grammar.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "like."
Key Points
  • "Like" is the appropriate word to use in this context to show a comparison between two things.
  • "As" is used to show a cause-and-effect relationship or to introduce a clause with a verb.
  • "Such" is used to introduce a clause that describes a specific characteristic or quality.
  • "Similarly" is used to show a comparison between two things, but it is often used to connect entire sentences rather than just one word.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Additional Information 

  • Option 1, "as," is a conjunction that can be used in a variety of ways, such as to introduce clauses with verbs or to show a comparison between two things.
  • Option 3, "such," is an adjective that is used to describe a specific characteristic or quality of something.
  • Option 4, "similarly," is an adverb that is used to show a comparison between two things, often in the context of connecting entire sentences.
